title: Geoeconomic Monitor: Russian Hopes, Chinese Fears
gist: Teaser of a Gavekal monthly: a putative US-Russia deal to resume Russian diesel exports is too small and uncertain to normalise global diesel prices into 2027; also covers a US-led anti-overcapacity trade bloc against China and new H-1B restrictions.

insights.claim: Gavekal's Tom Holland argues the targeted Russian diesel export volumes under a putative Trump-Putin deal are too small, shipments too uncertain and crude market disruptions too large to restore normal global diesel prices into 2027.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Do not expect a diesel-price relief trade from the deal; distillate cracks may stay elevated into 2027.

insights.claim: The US administration is attempting to forge a trade bloc to counter Chinese industrial overcapacity, examined by Tom Miller, but the teaser gives no detail on its design or members.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Watch for bloc formation as a new trade-policy vector against China.

insights.claim: Washington's latest restrictions on the H-1B visa program, analysed by Udith Sikand, affect Indian tech workers employed in the US, though the paywalled text does not state the effects.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Possible pressure on Indian IT services and US tech labour supply; details paywalled.
